segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report the stick does not irritate or cause breakouts and several call it their go-to for eczema-prone or sensitive family members, though one dissenting user with sensitive skin found it too thick to warm up and unusable as a stick.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report it does not feel greasy or add oiliness and one calls it the best facial sunscreen for oily acne-prone skin, though one reviewer with normal-to-oily skin found the lotion version left her face feeling oily.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as gentle and non-drying, with one recommending it for dry or eczema-prone skin, while one reviewer found the stick's application too dry and hard to spread.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin that gets oily in certain situations found the lotion version left her face feeling oily.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers use it specifically to prevent premature aging or wrinkles as part of a daily routine; none report negative effects tied to this concern.
concerns.dehydration: Some reviewers say it keeps skin moisturized or hydrating even under sun exposure, though one reviewer found the stick's texture too dry on application.
concerns.redness: No reviewer specifically discusses redness as a distinct concern.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema or compromised skin (including a child with eczema) report no irritation and that it can be applied in a thick layer without issue.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with a birthmark that darkens in sun reports this is the only sunscreen brand that has helped with that concern.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers say it does not make them break out, one specifically citing the mineral formula; no reviewer reports new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers report it is not greasy or oily on the skin and even praise it for controlling shine, but one reviewer says the lotion version consistently makes her face feel oily and another describes the stick itself as greasy and leaving skin white.

extraits.texte: This stuff is amazing. I have oily acne prone skin so I can't use the greasy sunscreens. This stuff is hands down the BEST sunscreen for my face that I've tried. Once it's absorbed into the skin, there isnt a white cast at all!

We use CeraVe religiously in our household because my 20m son has had terrible eczema. I was scared to try any other brand of sunscreen so I tried this and have no complaints! The sunscreen glides on well for my son and he spent 2+ hours in direct sunlight without a burn. I've seen people complaining about the white residue being hard to rub in and, since my sons skin is sensitive, I didn't try. I wanted a thick layer to protect his skin so I'm very happy with this product.

This stuff is pretty good, I use the version that's in a lotion form. It does the trick, but always makes my face feel oily for some reason. Maybe it's not good for my skin type! I have normal skin but it's prone to get oily in certain situations.

I love all my CeraVe products, but I'm not thrilled with this one. Can't take it to the beach where you need it- it turns to goo and you can't use it as a stick without spreading too much on your face. I wasted a big part of the package when I tried to use it- it can't get warm. Not "invisible". It's white. I don't really care about that part, but it's not clear. It does stay on in the pool for a long swim. Overall disappointing
This sunscreen is great for those with eczema prone, dry, or sensitive skin. It can leave a tad of a white cast for Black people/darker skin tones, but I would still recommend.

After finding cerave sunscreen I haven't bought any other brand. I have a birthmark on my face that gets darker in the sun this is the only sunscreen brand that I have found that lasts and really does help.￼
It was too dry and the application was hard to go on not my go to sunscreen I prefer the tinted sunscreen over this one!
